profile.headline: Software Engineer with expertise in API development
profile.summary:
As a software engineer, I apply my expertise in API development and testing to improve the functionality and user experience of various applications. I have over 8 years of industry experience in back-end development, working with various programming languages, databases, and infrastructure tools.

I have successfully led and completed several application development projects, achieving significant improvements in performance, efficiency, and reliability. Some of my notable achievements include building a RESTful testing application that increased performance testing efficiency by 70%, and developing a database migration tool that reduced the time of migration by 90%. I am proactive, adaptable, and passionate about learning new technologies and solving problems. My goal is to contribute to Apple's mission of creating innovative and impactful products.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Led the development of new microservice in Spring framework with Kafka MQ as backend
● Collaborated with cross-functional team and participated in design and implementation of new core mail feature
● Participated in an project to support DevOps by migrating prod instances to AWS and upgrading them without disturbing services
● Improved the stability of Nodejs client automation tests and achieved 75% less test failures by identifying and resolving issues
● Identified and resolved issues in mail backend server, and improved stability and efficiency
● Wrote and maintained unit and integration tests to ensure the stability and reliability of the server and APIs
● Developed and maintained technical documentations for new features and enhancements
● Improved debugging experience in backend server by revising Gradle and log4j2 configurations
positions.insights: Skills: Reactive Programming · Software Development · Gradle · Apache Kafka · Nodejs · Python · Spring Framework · Databases · Java · Cassandra · Log4j

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented web application powered by Nodejs for internal performance testing, removed error-prone setup environment step during functional/performance testing
● Achieved 30% faster test duration by Introducing new automation testing framework for web/android application
● Built a database migration tool powered by Java and performed major DB migration of millions of users between two different databases, achieved 90% reduced time of migration
● Built, managed scripts for performance testing, and conducted performance tests and organized results to enhance the performance of BBM

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
● Received and fixed bug reports from QA in commercial Java application
● Identified and investigated on memory leak issue in Java application by researching garbage collector in JVM and multi-threaded environment
● Experienced and learned debugging in Java application with thread dump
positions.insights: Skills: Garbage Collection · Java Virtual Machine (JVM) · Java

positions.title: Back-end developer
positions.description:

● Implemented Mock test suite in Python codebase for new features and APIs

positions.title: Solutions Developer
positions.description:
● Built web application displaying visualized statistics from Omniture with Ruby on Rails
● Collected user-generated click events on the sites and generated reports for executive managements
● Experienced large scale data warehouse provided from Amazon (AWS), and Hadoop

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:

● Worked on Microsoft Kinect application to upgrade current internal information system

positions.title: SQL developer
positions.description:
● Fixed critical errors reported on current SQL software from QA department
● Conducted an experiment to improve performance of Sybase SQL
● Understood internal mechanism of SQL and its basic procedure of handling commands
● Acquired senior level of understanding in SQL and basic idea of code sharing with CVS

projects.title: Start-up project

● Implemented and maintained UI and client-side code with Flutter framework
